title: 高密度互連電路板
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究微孔、增層與高密度逃線；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate microvias, buildup and dense escape routing. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 逃線與結構
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「逃線與結構」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for escape and structure.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Pad pitch, channel width and via lands constrain escape routing. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Map paths and bottlenecks for inner and outer pad rings. steps.title: BGA 逃線：量測與判別
